entries.name: identifier
entries.domain: non-empty Unicode string constrained by the owning schema
entries.canonical_rule: preserve exact code points after schema-level normalisation; identifiers are case-sensitive

entries.name: exact-decimal
entries.domain: finite base-10 decimal encoded as a string
entries.canonical_rule: optional minus, one zero or non-zero integer prefix, optional fractional digits; remove redundant trailing fractional zeros and negative zero

entries.name: bounded-integer
entries.canonical_rule: base-10 mathematical integer with no representation metadata

entries.name: enum
entries.domain: one exact member of a versioned schema-declared vocabulary
entries.canonical_rule: retain the stable member identity, not a display label

entries.name: unit
entries.domain: registered unit identity with explicit reference basis
entries.canonical_rule: normalise only through a registered exact conversion; otherwise preserve authored unit

entries.name: map
entries.canonical_rule: sort keys lexicographically by Unicode code point and canonicalise each value recursively

entries.name: set
entries.canonical_rule: canonicalise members, reject duplicates, then order by canonical bytes

entries.name: sequence
entries.canonical_rule: preserve authored element order and canonicalise members recursively

entries.name: tagged-union
entries.domain: one registered variant selected by an explicit stable discriminator
entries.canonical_rule: canonicalise the discriminator and only the fields admitted by that variant

entries.name: explicit-absence
entries.canonical_rule: encode absence as a tagged state; omission is not equivalent unless the schema says so

entries.name: explicit-default
entries.domain: schema-versioned default with stable semantic identity
entries.canonical_rule: record DEFAULT plus the exact schema version that defines its value

entries.name: executable-ir
entries.canonical_rule: include operator identities, operands, dependencies, numerical mode, tolerances, and boundary semantics

entries.name: evidence-ref
entries.canonical_rule: retain event identity, provenance, scope, coverage, lifecycle, and evidence strength

entries.name: witness-ref
entries.canonical_rule: retain runner semantics, inputs, assertions, coverage, dependencies, result, and lifecycle
